getUserDetails: SELECT id, username, password, api_key, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ollama_users WHERE username = %s
registerUsers: INSERT INTO store (username, email, password, age) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s) RETURNING id;
getAllUsers: SELECT id, username, password, api_key, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ollama_users;
getUsersDetailNameorEmail: SELECT id, username, email, password, status FROM store WHERE (username = %s OR email = %s) LIMIT 1;
setAPIKey: UPDATE store SET api_key = %s, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = %s RETURNING id;
authenticateAPIKey: SELECT username, api_key FROM store WHERE api_key = %s
